dialog.title: Will / inheritance contract
dialog.description: Notarial will for the binding regulation of the estate. More secure than a handwritten will and immediately enforceable.
step.form.title: Form of disposition
field.testamentsform.label: Which form is desired?
field.testamentsform.helpText: Berlin Will: spouses appoint each other as sole heirs. Joint will: drawn up jointly, with or without binding effect. Inheritance contract: notarial, contractually binding.
field.anzahl_erblasser.label: Number of testators
field.verhaeltnis_testierende.label: Relationship of the testators

field.bestehendes_testament_info.placeho: e.g. date, summary of content, place of safekeeping
field.bestehendes_testament_scan.label: Scan of the existing will / inheritance contract
field.bestehendes_testament_scan.helpTex: We expressly request a scan of the document – this greatly facilitates processing.

step.erben.title: Heirs & legacies
field.anzahl_eingesetzte_erben.label: How many persons should become heir(s)?
field.eingesetzte_erben.label: Heir
field.ersatzerbe.label: Substitute heir(s) desired?
field.ersatzerbe.helpText: Who inherits if the appointed heir predeceases the testator or disclaims?
field.ersatzerbe.option.Ja, Abkömmlinge: Yes, descendants of the appointed heirs
field.ersatzerbe_name.label: Name of the substitute heir(s)
field.vermaechtnisse.label: Should legacies be granted?
field.vermaechtnisse.helpText: Legacy: specific items/amounts to persons who do not become heirs.
field.vermaechtnisse_info.label: Legacies – to whom, what?
field.vermaechtnisse_info.placeholder: e.g. my car to my nephew Max Müller
field.auflagen.label: Conditions (Auflagen)?
field.auflagen.helpText: Condition: the heir must do something, without anyone having a claim (e.g. grave care).
field.auflagen_info.label: Description of the conditions

field.testamentsvollstrecker.label: Executor desired?
field.testamentsvollstrecker.helpText: Person who handles the administration of the estate.
field.testamentsvollstrecker_name.label: Name of the executor
field.testamentsvollstrecker_dauer.label: Duration of the executorship
field.enterbung.label: Should anyone be disinherited?
field.enterbung_info.label: Who and why?
field.bindungswirkung.label: Should the surviving testator be able to amend the will / inheritance contract after the other's death?
field.bindungswirkung.helpText: Binding effect: after the death of the first to die, the survivor can no longer change it.
field.bindungswirkung_info.label: Which parts should be amendable?
field.rechtswahl.label: Choice of German law?
field.rechtswahl.helpText: Sensible in case of (planned) emigration or other foreign element.

field.dokumente.helpText: E.g. existing will, family certificates, land register extract.
